newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian ceramic tiles firm to seek listing.
newsitem.headline: Italian ceramic tiles firm to seek listing.

text.p: Italian ceramics firm Gruppo Ceramiche Ricchetti is to list on the Milan bourse at the end of the month, the first such company to seek a listing.
The group, based in Modena, is a leading producer of glazed tiles and had a net profit in 1995 of 4.8 billion lire on sales of 274 billion lire.

The company intends to use proceeds from the listing to reduce net debt which totalled 89.5 billion lire at the end of May. The company is currently 77 percent-owned by Fincisa with the balance held by Milan finance house Akros. Milan newsroom +392-66102321
